Release v1.6.1a (5 February 2020) |previous_update = [[Release v1.5|Christmas 2019 Update]] |next_update = [[Release v1.7]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Release v1.6''' was the eighteenth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 12th of January 2020. It added multiple skins, balance changes and later the exclusive [[Mecha Base]] tower. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''Release v1.6''' has been retroactively applied to this update. This version encompassed four updates, the main Release v1.6.0 update (12 January 2020) and threeminor updates, the Release v1.6.0a (released the same day as Release v1.6.0, 12 January 2020), the Release v1.6.1 (released 26 January 2020) and the Release v1.6.1a (released 5 February 2020). ==Additions== ===Towers=== :In '''v1.6.1''': *[[Mecha Base]] (exclusive) ===Skins=== *New skins for the
